name: TestRerun
description: Run dotnet test and rerun the failed tests with dotnet-test-rerun.
author: joaoopereira

inputs.name: path
inputs.label: Path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Solution, project or folder to test. Empty runs dotnet test in the working directory.

inputs.name: arguments
inputs.label: Arguments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Other test-rerun options, for example `--configuration Release --rerunMaxAttempts 3`. Don't pass `--results-directory` here. See [usage](https://joaoopereira.github.io/dotnet-test-rerun/usage).

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: Tool version
inputs.helpMarkDown: dotnet-test-rerun version to install. Empty installs the latest release on every run.

inputs.name: resultsDirectory
inputs.label: Results directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder for the TRX files of every run.

inputs.name: workingDirectory
inputs.label: Working directory
inputs.helpMarkDown: Folder to run from. Defaults to the sources folder.

inputs.name: publishTestResults
inputs.label: Publish test results
inputs.helpMarkDown: Publish the TRX files to the Tests tab, even when tests fail.

inputs.name: testRunTitle
inputs.label: Test run title
inputs.helpMarkDown: Title of the published test run.

outputVariables.name: resultsDirectory
outputVariables.description: Folder that holds the TRX files of every run.
